# Tasks & Design Notes: Startwell (ColorLib Startright)

## Overview

- **Source Template**: ColorLib Startright (`https://colorlib.com/wp/template/startright/`)
- **New App Name**: `startwell`
- **Package**: `@free-react-templates/startwell`
- **Domain**: `startwell.free.componentdock.com`

## Section Order & Architecture

1. `Navbar.tsx`: Sticky/fixed top navbar with brand and links.
2. `Hero.tsx`: Headline, CTA, hero graphic.
3. `Clients.tsx`: "As seen on" brand logos row.
4. `Solutions.tsx`: 3-column value proposition and overview.
5. `Productivity.tsx`: Detailed feature split with quote block.
6. `Stats.tsx`: Numerical impact counters.
7. `Features.tsx`: 6-card feature grid with Lucide icons.
8. `Footer.tsx`: Links columns, newsletter signup, Component Dock attribution.

## Design Fidelity Notes

- **Colors**: Primary warm amber `#f2ad5f`, dark navy slate `#252837`, light background `#f8f9fa`.
- **Typography**: Poppins sans-serif font applied globally via Tailwind CSS theme.
- **Components**: Fully modular React 19 functional components using Lucide icons.
